title: Sherpa Audit Events v1
description: Wire schema for audit events surfaced via GET /api/v1/audit/events (audit.basic capability) and bundled into report packs as audit_export.{csv,jsonl}. Published by OSS so external consumers (lab QA, regulatory reviewers, third-party tooling) can validate exports independently of the running server. The corresponding Pydantic source of truth is spectra_sherpa.app.schemas.audit.AuditEventOut.

actor_kind.description: Originator of the action. user/api_key require actor_id; system/webhook may have actor_id=null and a system_actor string in context.

iso_utc_datetime.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with timezone offset. Always emitted with +00:00 by the server.

id.description: Auto-increment row id. Stable forensic ordering within a tenant when paired with tenant_sequence on the chain row.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. 'default' for OSS Local; deployment-key id for hosted.

actor_id.description: FK to user.id when actor_kind in {user, api_key}. NULL for actor_kind in {system, webhook}.

target_type.description: Class name of the audited entity. Examples: 'Workflow', 'Experiment', 'ExperimentFile', 'ModelArtifact', 'Project', 'AuditExport', 'ReportPack'.

target_id.description: Stable identifier for the audited entity. Integer-as-string for ORM rows; opaque string for server-minted artefacts.

before_state.description: State snapshot before the mutation. NULL on creation events.

after_state.description: State snapshot after the mutation. NULL on deletion events.

context.description: Action-class-specific payload. For workflow.run.* events, carries the minimum reproducibility record (see docs/audit/minimum-reproducibility-record.md).

ts_app_utc.description: Wall-clock UTC at the application layer when the event was constructed.

ts_db_utc.description: Wall-clock UTC at the database when the row landed (server_default=func.now()).

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination token. When non-null, pass back as ?cursor= on the next request to continue. Currently the integer id of the last returned row, serialised as a string for forward compatibility.

has_more.description: True when at least one row exists beyond the page boundary.
